tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pt.TrackId, t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId
GROUP BY pt.TrackId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) AS cnt
    FROM PlaylistTrack
    GROUP BY TrackId
  )
)
ORDER BY playlist_count DESC, t.Name;"}
